title: Section 300.6(B) – Revise Section 300.6(B) to read as follows:
officialText:
(B) Aluminum Metal Equipment. Aluminum raceways, cable trays, cable bus, auxiliary gutters, cable armor, boxes,
cable sheathing, cabinets, elbows, couplings, nipples, fittings, supports, and support hardware shall not be embedded
in concrete or come in direct contact with the earth unless provided with a protective coating by the manufacturer that
is listed for use in direct burial and concrete encasement applications.
